scope.change: The Forms Admin inbox shows the count of unexpired submissions in the existing new state for the selected site-owned form. The count refreshes after form selection, explicit refresh, status change, visibility return and every 60 seconds while the page is visible.
scope.read_state: Reuses the existing form_submissions.status lifecycle: changing a submission to reviewed clears it from the notice. No separate notification inbox or duplicate business state is introduced.
scope.privacy: The count query returns only an integer and is scoped by the authenticated site grant and selected site-owned form. It does not read or return values_json, email, consent text, IP digest or submission identifiers.
scope.delivery: Explicitly an in-app Forms inbox notice only; it makes no email, push, or external delivery claim.
scope.schema_or_production_data: No D1 schema, migration, or data mutation; no R2 operation.
scope.dependencies_and_cost: No new dependency, paid provider, quota use or new cost (0 HUF).
